verses.1: Then the angel showed me Joshua the high priest standing before the angel
verses.2: And the LORD said to Satan: “The LORD rebukes you, Satan! Indeed, the LORD, who has chosen Jerusalem, rebukes you! Is not this man a firebrand ”
verses.3: Now Joshua was dressed in filthy garments as he stood before the angel.
verses.4: So the angel said to those standing before him, “Take off his filthy clothes!” Then he said to Joshua, “See, I have removed your iniquity, and I will clothe you with splendid robes.”
verses.5: Then I said, “Let them put a clean turban on his head.” So a clean turban was placed on his head, and they clothed him, as the angel of the LORD stood by.
verses.6: Then the angel of the LORD gave this charge to Joshua:
verses.7: “This is what the LORD of Hosts says: ‘If you walk in My ways and keep My instructions, then you will govern My house and will also have charge of My courts; and I will give you a place among these who are standing here.
verses.8: Hear now, O high priest Joshua, you and your companions seated before you, who are indeed a sign. For behold, I am going to bring My servant, the Branch.
verses.9: See the stone I have set before Joshua; on that one stone are seven eyes.
verses.10: On that day, declares the LORD of Hosts, you will each invite your neighbor to sit under your own vine and fig tree.’”
